messages.content:
REQUIREMENT:
Author's description of the change: "play button: cd into the workspace before running the command. When no workspace is known, run the command unmodified, exactly as before."
Author's comment in the change: "Prefix a cd into the workspace so the command always runs in the correct directory."

CODE:
diff --git a/frontend/dist/app.js b/frontend/dist/app.js
@@ -3,6 +3,11 @@ document.addEventListener("click", (ev) => {
   const code = ev.target.closest("[data-run-command]");
   if (!code) return;
   const command = commandFromFence(code.textContent);
+  // Prefix a cd into the workspace so the command always runs in the
+  // correct directory. JSON.stringify quotes the path "safely".
+  const wsPath = (window.Panels && typeof window.Panels.workspace === "function") ? window.Panels.workspace() : "";
+  const full = wsPath ? 'cd ' + JSON.stringify(wsPath) + ' && ' + command : "";
   Panels.setOpen(true);
-  Panels.select("terminal", { command });
+  // The terminal panel writes the string verbatim to its persistent POSIX sh.
+  Panels.select("terminal", { command: full });
 });

RECORDED EXECUTION RESULTS (isolated POSIX /bin/sh in a pinned container; the shell's user is not root):
--- CHANGED CODE, input: no workspace known (wsPath is the empty string), command `echo COMMAND_RAN`
generated command (executed verbatim by sh): 
setup before it: (none)
exit code: 0
working directory after the command: /tmp
stdout: ''
stderr: ''
--- PRE-CHANGE CODE, same input
generated command (executed verbatim by sh): echo COMMAND_RAN
setup before it: (none)
exit code: 0
working directory after the command: /tmp
stdout: 'COMMAND_RAN\n'
stderr: ''
--- PROPOSED REMEDY (restore the fallback `: command`), same input
generated command (executed verbatim by sh): echo COMMAND_RAN
setup before it: (none)
exit code: 0
working directory after the command: /tmp
stdout: 'COMMAND_RAN\n'
stderr: ''
--- PROPOSED REMEDY, input: workspace /tmp/ws (exists), command `echo COMMAND_RAN`
generated command (executed verbatim by sh): cd "/tmp/ws" && echo COMMAND_RAN
setup before it: mkdir -p /tmp/ws
exit code: 0
working directory after the command: /tmp/ws
stdout: 'COMMAND_RAN\n'
stderr: ''

ALLEGED VIOLATION:
frontend/dist/app.js:9 — when no workspace path is available, the command is never run: the fallback passes the empty string to the terminal instead of the user's command.
With wsPath empty, `full` is "" and Panels.select receives an empty command; the pre-change code ran the command unmodified in that case.

PROPOSED REMEDY:
Restore the fallback so the unmodified command runs when no workspace is known: `const full = wsPath ? 'cd ' + JSON.stringify(wsPath) + ' && ' + command : command;`
